question: Which of the following foods is a rich source of dietary fibre for human beings?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Oats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Oats** are a rich source of dietary fibre, especially **beta-glucan**, which is beneficial for maintaining a healthy digestive system.
 
• Dietary fibre in oats aids in **regulating blood sugar levels** and reducing **cholesterol levels**.
 
• They are considered a **whole grain**, making them a nutritious choice for human diets.
 
• Oats contain both **soluble and insoluble fibre**, which contribute to overall gut health and help in preventing constipation.
 
• Rich in nutrients like **vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants**, oats are beneficial for overall health.
 
• Oats are used in a variety of foods, including **breakfast cereals, granola bars, and baked goods**.
 
• They are also gluten-free, making them a suitable choice for individuals with **gluten intolerance or celiac disease**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chicken**__

 __
 
• **Chicken** is a rich source of **protein** and essential nutrients such as **vitamins B6 and B12, iron, and zinc**.
 
• It is not a significant source of dietary fibre as animal-based foods generally lack fibre.
 
• Chicken is commonly used in various cuisines worldwide and can be prepared in numerous ways, including grilling, roasting, and frying.
 
 
 
• **Cheese**__
 __
 
• **Cheese** is a dairy product made from milk and is rich in **calcium, protein, and fats**.
 
• It does not contain dietary fibre as it is derived from animal sources.
 
• Different types of cheese, such as cheddar, mozzarella, and parmesan, are used in various dishes globally.
 
 
 
• **Fish**__
 
 
• **Fish** is an excellent source of **protein** and **omega-3 fatty acids**, which are beneficial for heart and brain health.
 
• Like other animal-based foods, fish lacks dietary fibre.
 
• Commonly consumed fish include **salmon, tuna, mackerel, and cod**, and they are used in both traditional and modern cuisines.
